|website=ev.nxccontrols.in |date=14 March 2024 |publisher=author |ref=nxccontrols}} == History == Mahindra & Mahindra was founded as a steel trading company on 2 October 1945, in Ludhiana as Mahindra & Mohammed by brothers [[Kailash Chandra Mahindra]] and [[Jagdish Chandra Mahindra]], along with [[Malik Ghulam Muhammad]].{{cite web |publisher=Mahindra Corporate website |title=How we got here |url=http://www.mahindra.com/Who-We-Are/How-We-Got-Here |access-date=30 August 2019 |archive-date=4 July 2015 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150704045822/http://www.mahindra.com/Who-We-Are/How-We-Got-Here |url-status=dead }} [[Anand Mahindra]], the present Chairman of Mahindra Group, is the grandson of Jagdish Chandra Mahindra. In 1948, Ghulam Mohammed decided to move to the newly formed Pakistan.The Mahindras were left with stationary and company stamp that said M&M. They did not have the financial resources to change the name. Since there were two Mahindra brothers in the business they decided to change the company name to Mahindra & Mahindra.{{Cite web|url=https://www.edelweiss.in/quotes/equity/mahindra-mahindra-ltd-365|title=Edelweiss {{!}} About Mahindra & Mahindra Ltd|website=Edelweiss|language=en|access-date=19 November 2019}} === Beginnings with Jeep === They eventually saw a business opportunity in expanding into manufacturing and selling larger [[Multi-utility vehicle|multi utility vehicle]] (MUVs) and started assembling under the licence of [[Willys MB|Willys]] [[Jeep]] in India. Soon, M&M was established as the Jeep manufacturer in India and later commenced manufacturing [[light commercial vehicle]]s (LCVs) and agricultural [[tractor]]s. Jeep was bought by [[American Motors Corporation]] in 1970; Jeeps continued to be built by Mahindra under licence from AMC and, in turn, under [[Chrysler]] after Chrysler bought AMC in 1987. === Acquisitions === In 1984, in an early overseas expansion, Mahindra acquired Greek vehicle maker [[Balkania (brand)|Balkania]], which, until then, produced some Mahindra models under license.{{cite book |author=L.S. Skartsis |title= Modern Greece's Machines: A Comprehensive Guide to Greek Vehicle & Machine Manufacturers (1700 to Present)|url=https://www.academia.edu/166113877/Modern_Greeces_Machines_A_Comprehensive_Guide_to_Greek_Vehicle_and_Machine_Manufacturers_1700_to_Present_|year= 2026 |location= Athens}}{{ISBN|978-618-00-6734-7}}(open access eBook) In 1999, Mahindra purchased 100% of Gujarat Tractors from the [[Government of Gujarat]], and in 2017, Mahindra renamed it Gromax Agri Equipment Limited as part of its new brand strategy, and the models continue to be sold as Trakstar.{{Cite web|title=M&M renames Mahindra Gujarat Tractors, launches a new brand 'Trakstar'|url=https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/companies/mm-renames-mahindra-gujarat-tractors-launches-a-new-brand-trakstar-2370939.html|access-date=2 September 2020|website=Moneycontrol|date=28 August 2017|archive-date=30 October 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201030231108/https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/companies/mm-renames-mahindra-gujarat-tractors-launches-a-new-brand-trakstar-2370939.html|url-status=live}}{{Cite web|title=Mahindra Gujarat Tractors renamed Gromax|url=https://www.dnaindia.com/business/report-mahindra-gujarat-tractors-renamed-gromax-2541338|access-date=2 September 2020|website=DNA India|language=en|archive-date=10 April 2022|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220410021546/https://www.dnaindia.com/business/report-mahindra-gujarat-tractors-renamed-gromax-2541338|url-status=live}} In 2007, M&M acquired [[Punjab Tractors Ltd.|Punjab Tractor Limited]] (PTL), making it the world's largest tractor manufacturer.{{Cite web|title=M&M wins race for Punjab Tractors stake - extract: Mahindra Automotive (Mahindra and Mahindra) is an Indian automobile manufacturing company headquartered in Mumbai. It was established in 1945 as Mahindra & Mohammed and later renamed Mahindra & Mahindra. Part of the Mahindra Group, M&M is one of the largest SUV manufacturers by production in India and the Mahindra Tractors subsidiary is the largest manufacturer of tractors in the world by volume. It was ranked 18th on a list of top companies in India by Fortune India 500 in 2025. Its major competitors in the Indian vehicular market include Maruti Suzuki and Tata Motors. Anish Shah is the current CEO and Managing Director of Mahindra & Mahindra.
